tests.reason: Passes, but costs ~14.8 billion emulated Z80 cycles (~14s even unthrottled) - by far the single most expensive case in the whole extended suite, from a deliberately unpruned whole-board recheck per candidate cell in 8-queens. tests/00040b.c (run by the standard, non-extended suite) exercises the identical constructs - recursion with globals, calloc, K&R-style declarations, non-short-circuiting '&' in boolean context - at a smaller board size for ~8x less cost; see that file's header comment.
